string.text: Hey there, stalker! What brings you here?
I'm here on business. Can you point me to whoever's in charge?
Head to the main hall.
Hey. I looks like you've got a nice setup here.
Hey to you too! Yeah, we picked ourselves a quieter spot, so to speak... Though as you can see, all kinds of scum have taken a liking to this place as well.
How are you managing to hold up here? Almost everything around here is contaminated.
That's just how it is! This area is relatively clean, so that's why we hang around here... And honestly, if it comes to it, we'll move on somewhere else. Wouldn't be the first time...
See you around.
Was there something else?
I'll say this - you've made a pretty convincing case for yourself and what you're looking for.
Fair enough. So what's the move this time?
What we need is raw materials. Not supplies, not artifacts... Raw materials.
Can you be more specific?
Flesh, we desire flesh...
The mutant? You need me to catch one of those things? Surely there's no shortage of them around here...
That's not what I meant, stalker. We need dead flesh from small animals. Meat. Grab a few rat and crow carcasses and bring them back. That should be enough...
Here, take your so called "flesh"...
Excellent...
That better be everything you need.
You held up your end of the deal... Now get out of here while you still can. Because who knows if you'd be lucky enough to come back a second time...
I heard you're looking for something in the Zone. Care to tell me more about it?

About six months back there was a serious incident - one that a lot of people went out of their way to bury. One night, kids from every surrounding settlement just got up and walked toward the Zone. All at once, like something called to them. \n \nI've been trying to track down what happened ever since, and I've got nothing... You wouldn't know anything about it, would you?

I had a vision in Pripyat... A child, twisting into some kind of monster right before my eyes. I snapped out of it... looked around - and there was a dwarf sitting right beside me. \n \nSo I killed him - stabbed that fucker right in the face.
Hm... Visions in the Zone rarely come without reason, especially when you're that close to the Center. Let's hope there was some truth in what you saw.
Yeah... let's hope.
Well, well, well... Hello, Gunslinger.
Journalist?!
Indeed. Go ahead, ask what you need to ask.
What happened to me during my first trip to the Center of the Zone? Surely there was much that happened... right?

You put together a group and pushed toward the Center through Pripyat. You were trailing a large military unit when an emission hit... \n \nWhat happened after that, I can't tell you. What I do know is that somehow you ended up in a Death Truck, bound for the outer barrier.
What can you tell me about the Black Monolith?

You know, some things are not at all what they appear to be at first glance. The legendary "Wish Granter" is nothing more than a trap - a weapon in the hands of those who are behind everything that goes on here. \n \nThe true Center of the Zone is not at the CNPP, but beyond it, and all the answers lie there. I think if you can make it to the power station, we'll be able to figure out how to reach the true Center of the Zone.
I'm heading to the Sarcophagus... I think I finally know what I'm after...
The stalkers are dead... All of them.
Were you able to pick up anything from their conversation?
They were planning to storm your base.
Fools! They thought they had a chance against the wrath of our masters... \n \nBut you, stalker - you're clearly worth something. We'll be keeping an eye on you, Twice-Born.
If you spend the whole night sitting in a water tower, something is bound to happen...
Stalker, you're on our territory - don't even think about pulling anything! If you're looking to earn some money, you're welcome to come to our base.
Greetings.

Oh, a newcomer! We just got back from a raid ourselves... We've got something of a base here, though we're mostly a nomadic bunch. 
 
Hey, you didn't happen to come from Yantar, did you? Chrome mentioned something about some guy working with the Professor - real reliable type, knocking out jobs left and right... Anyway, we know about your talents, and we've actually got something suitable for you. 
 
Here's the situation: one of our squads was heading back from a raid near Yantar and just... vanished. They were moving along, joking around on the radio, no trouble at all - then they passed by the school and went dead silent. Like they dropped off the face of the earth. I'm afraid something's gone wrong... Could you go check it out? And after that, swing by and see our commander.
Alright, I'll go check it out.
Not right now.
A controller had your squad. I took it out - your guys are already heading back to base, safe and sound.
Damn... The thing must have been tailing them all the way from Yantar - that explains why they kept saying they were hearing voices! Thank you, stalker.
Yeah, most likely that's exactly what happened.
Anything else you need done?

We've been looking at expanding, but there's something going on in the building across from us. Windows shattering by themselves, furniture shifting around, strange lights flickering in the windows after dark... The whole thing is off. \n \nWe don't have the manpower to spare right now, and frankly nobody here is rushing to volunteer. But you've shown what you're made of. So what do you say - will you check it out?
I'll do it, let's find out what's going on over there.
Maybe another time.
There was a group of Poltergeists living in that building. Their racket and light shows won't be bothering you any longer.
Appreciate it again, stalker - really. Guys like you don't come around often out here. Most people wouldn't touch a job like that with a ten foot pole, let alone walk out of there in one piece...
Don't mention it. Good luck!
Investigate the building

If anyone should be saying thanks, it's me! After that whole mess at the checkpoint I had to make a run for it up north... \n \nIt's rough out here, sure, but it works in my favor - the soldiers won't come poking around this far. And right now they've got it out for me something fierce. Honestly, I don't even know if we'll be able to work together again after this...

Those Sinners... completely unhinged bunch. One of them came in here not long ago, walked up to the counter, stood there in silence for ten minutes, and then just left without saying a word... \n \nI mean, it's like something out of a horror movie, for god's sake! And then last night - I was just about to close up when a couple of those stoned freaks showed up. Planted themselves over there in the corner like statues and just stared at me. I told them to get the hell out, and they couldn't care less... To hell with them!
Go...
What do you want here?
I got a message from your leader.
A message? Now that's curious...
And who exactly are you?
Does it make a difference?
Fair enough, probably not.
Smart thinking, stalker. And listen - I can hook you up with a valuable artifact... in exchange for a Dead Head. What do you say?
No.
Then beat it!
Oh, absolutely - right away. Heh-heh.
Here, take it.
Then let's make this deal...
Good luck.
You got the artifact?
